youtube.title: Stop Sign Octagon kyun hota hai? 🛑 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Amreeka ke har stop sign ke aath kone hote hain. Circle ya square kyun nahi? Satrah sau teis, yaani 1923 mein gaadiyan nayi thi, sadkon par afra-tafri thi, aur har sheher apne alag sign banata tha. Tab Chicago mein state highway engineers ek saath baithe is problem ko fix karne ke liye.

Unka idea simple tha: sign ke jitne zyada kone, utni khatarnak jagah. Railroad crossing sabse khatarnak, isliye uske liye circle. Aur intersection par rukne ke liye aath kone. Sabse bada twist ye ki pehle octagon stop sign red nahi, yellow the. Red paint dhoop mein jaldi fade ho jaata tha, aur 1950s mein jaakar stop sign red hue.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
